openwrt_git_add.titel: ipq807x: add support for Netgear WAX218
openwrt_git_add.beschreibung: 802.11ax AP claiming AX3600 support. It is wall or ceiling mountable. It can be powered via PoE, or a 12 V adapter.
openwrt_git_add.uart_hinweis: The board has footprints for 2.54mm UART headers. They're difficult to solder because the GND is connected to a large copper plane. Only try soldering if you are very skilled. Otherwise, use pogo pins.
openwrt_git_add.RAM: 366 MB of RAM available to OS, not sure of total amount
openwrt_git_add.UART: Two 4-pin unpopulated headers near the LEDs; "J2 UART" is the CPU UART, 3.3 V level
openwrt_git_add.Installation: Web UI method (web-ui-factory.fit über System Manager -> Firmware, danach nand-sysupgrade.bin) oder SSH method (ubiformat mtd12, fw_setenv active_fw); Einzelheiten im Commit

netgear_datenblatt.Titel: WiFi 6 AX3600 PoE Access Point (Data Sheet | WAX218)
netgear_datenblatt.Power Supply: 12V/2.5V (30W) Power adapter (included with WAX218PA model only) or PoE/PoE+ Switch
netgear_datenblatt.Ethernet Ports: One (1) 100/1000/2500Mbps Ethernet (RJ-45) PoE port with Auto Uplink (Auto MDI-X)

netgear_installguide.Titel: WiFi 6 AX3600 Dual Band PoE+ Access Point Model WAX218 Installation Guide
netgear_installguide.Package contents: Access Point WAX218; Mounting bracket with screw holes for mounting to a solid ceiling or 15/16 in. (23.8 mm) T-bar; Two screws and anchors for ceiling or wall mounting; Power adapter (varies by region)
netgear_installguide.Overview: 1 5 GHz WLAN LED, 2 2.4 GHz WLAN LED, 3 LAN LED, 4 Power LED, 5 Reset button, 6 LAN/PoE+ port, 7 DC power connector
netgear_installguide.Power: LAN/PoE+ port to a PoE+ switch that supplies 802.3at (PoE+) power, or to a power adapter
netgear_installguide.LAN: LAN/PoE+ port supports Ethernet speeds up to 2.5 Gbps
netgear_installguide.LEDs: Power solid amber; LAN solid/blinking blue; 2.4 GHz WLAN blue; 5 GHz WLAN blue
netgear_installguide.Reset: If the management SSID turned off during setup, press the Reset button for 20 seconds to reset the device to default settings
netgear_installguide.Management SSID: WAX218XXXXXX-CONFIG-ONLY (letzte 6 Stellen der MAC), Passwort auf dem Etikett
netgear_installguide.Mounting: solid wall (two holes on the bottom, screws 4.33 in. (110 mm) apart, 6 mm protruding), solid ceiling (bracket), 15/16 in. (23.8 mm) T-bar, or freestanding on a flat surface; flat Ethernet cable recommended
netgear_installguide.Regulatory: Do not use this device outdoors. The PoE source is intended for intra building connection only.

netgear_handbuch.Unterschiede WAX214/WAX218: WAX218: 3600 Mbps (1200 + 2400), PoE+ (802.at) wenn ohne Netzteil, LAN max. 2.5 Gbps, 8.0 x 8.0 x 1.37 in (205.7 x 205.7 x 35.8 mm)
netgear_handbuch.Hardware Overview: indoor, standalone access point; single 2.5 Gbps PoE LAN port, PoE+ (802.3at) switch; power adapter supplied for WAX218PA, option for WAX218
netgear_handbuch.Unpack: WAX218, mounting bracket (solid ceiling or 15/16 in. (23.8 mm) T-bar), two screws and anchors, installation guide; je nach Bestellung Netzteil
netgear_handbuch.LEDs: Oberseite: 5 GHz WLAN, 2.4 GHz WLAN, LAN (blau), Power (amber)
netgear_handbuch.Bottom panel: LAN/PoE+ port, Reset button, DC power connector for optional power adapter
netgear_handbuch.Reset: about two seconds = restart; 10 seconds or longer = factory default settings
netgear_handbuch.PoE-Hinweis: If you use a PoE (803.2.af) switch, the access point might not receive sufficient power for normal operation.
netgear_handbuch.Kensington: The back panel provides a Kensington lock slot for an optional security cable.
netgear_handbuch.Label (Abb. 6): NETGEAR WiFi 6 AX3600 Dual Band PoE+ Wireless Access Point WAX218; FCC ID: A8J-EWS377APV3; Input: 12V 2.5A; Made in Taiwan; 272-13660-02; Felder SERIAL, MAC, SSID, Network Key
netgear_handbuch.Anschlussfeld (Abb. 5): Reset (Loch) | LAN/PoE+ | 12V 2.5A mit Polaritätssymbol Mitte plus
